lines.text: Moran grabs the boy by his collar.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Gotcha.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I noticed there was someone hanging around the set for a while now.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Who are you? What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Wait, aren't you the kid I walked home before?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: L-let go of me!

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Not gonna happen. What are you doing back here, anyway? I thought you hated the Ark Rangers.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: You planning on sabotaging our shoot?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm not, so let go!

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Say please.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Say it.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: P-please let go.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: There you go.
Moran releases Luke's collar.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Again, why are you hanging around here? This is supposed to be a closed set.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Not going to talk?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Fine then. I'll call the cops.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I-I came to see for myself how fake the Ark Rangers are.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: You're kidding, right? A kid like you doesn't go through all this trouble just for that.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Be honest. Why are you here?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Did you come to apologize?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Hmm...
There's a commotion in one corner of the set.
Tense cries and loud sighs echo through the set.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Looks like something happened.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: You stay here, kid. Don't move a...

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: On second thought, come with me. You'll get in trouble if someone spots you wandering around alone.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: If anyone asks, just say you're, uh... my little brother, okay?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Already learned how to keep quiet, have you? Anyway, let's go.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: It's Ark Leon...!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: ... Wait, how did you get in here?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Uh, I'll explain later. What happened?
Ark Ranger Red silently raises her hand and gestures forward.
On the large screen monitoring the surface,
Ark Leon is shown being pushed back by the incoming Raptures.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Check Ark Leon's status!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Its output is dropping! It's taken too much damage!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Hm... It's time to fall back...

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: No! I can't!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Matis is fighting off a lot of the Raptures, but there are too many of them!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: If I retreat now, the Raptures will make it into the Ark!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: I'm going stop them, even if it kills me!

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: I won't let anyone die again!
*Boom!*
Ark Leon begins its counterattack.
Moran turns her head and looks at Luke.
Luke stands there, fists clenched, unable to take his eyes off the screen.
Moran approaches him quietly.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: So? What do you think?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: ... It's just all fake anyway.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: You think that's fake?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: The way she shouts as she's fighting with everything she's got... Does that seem fake to you?

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: When she shielded you from that Rapture that attacked,

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: did all those bullet holes in her look fake?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: She couldn't save Hope.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: If she were a real hero, she would've saved him.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: ... Even real heroes can fail. You know that.
*Boom!*
Ark Leon falls after being struck by a Rapture attack.
It doesn't get back up.

lines.speaker: black_op_l
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Black!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Looks like... that's it for me... Guess I wasn't a real hero... after all...

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Hope... I failed you again... I wish I could've rewarded your courage with something better...

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I don't know about you, but when I look at Ark Ranger Black,

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I see someone trying to be a hero in real life, beyond any screen.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: And you can help her.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: If you give her the courage, kid, she can become a real hero.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I had something similar happen to me.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: My subordinates once gave me a huge boost of courage,

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: and when they did, I felt a strength I didn't even know I had.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I was already the boss, but that was when I truly felt like one for the first time.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: It felt like I could do anything.
Moran rummages through her coat and pulls out a trading card in a plastic case.
She quietly holds it out to Luke.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: I wasn't there, so I don't know everything,

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: but your brother held onto this until the very end.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: That's why Ark Ranger Black was able to become a real hero before, even if only for a moment.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: She became a real hero and stood in front of your brother.
Luke takes the trading card.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: ... I said earlier that even real heroes can fail.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: It's precisely because they're real that they can fail.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: ... I understand you're sad and upset.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: But maybe it's time to forgive her.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Look at her. She's out there putting her life on the line.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: What do you think a hero is?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: ... Someone who can do anything.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Yeah, exactly.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Then give her courage, so that she can do anything.

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: Turn that Ark Ranger...

lines.speaker: moran_d
lines.text: ... into a real hero.
*Thud*
Ark Leon drops to one knee.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Ark Leon's output is still dropping! Continuing to fight is too dangerous!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oh non...

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: If this continues, Ark Ranger Black's safety cannot be guaranteed.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: ... Then we have no choice.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Black Ark Ranger, fall back...

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Get up, Ark Ranger!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Get up! Please! Get up!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I knew this whole time! I knew you risked your life to save Hope!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I know how hurt you got! And I know how you did your best!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I just... I just couldn't stand that Hope is gone!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: That's why I said those bad things! That's why I said you were a fake!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I'm sorry! I'm so sorry...!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I was sad that Hope died...!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: And I was also sad that the Ark Rangers lost...!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: The Ark Rangers I know never lose!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: As long as you have courage, you're unstoppable!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: So I'll give you my courage! You can have all of it!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Just don't lose again!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Never again...!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I don't want to see my hero lose ever again!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Hngaaahhh!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Thank you for your courage! I can feel it!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Your hero is never going to fall again...!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: As long as I have courage!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: am unstoppable!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Ark Leon's output is increasing!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Its Ark energy levels have surpassed critical limits!

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Wh-what is this...? It's incredible...!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Voilà... Behold the power of courage!
Ark Leon rushes forward.
It tears apart the Raptures blocking its path.
In the face of such overwhelming power,
everything nearby on the surface falls silent.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Ark Ranger...!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: A hero never falls!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: She's amazing...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Tch... She's stolen the spotlight.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Come on, we can't let her show us up. Right?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: That's right! Let's go!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Mustang.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Okay. Opérateur, préparez Ark Lander and Ark Falcon.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yes, sir! Ark Lander, Ark Falcon, prepare for deployment!
Ark Rangers Red and Blue take off running.
Luke watches them as they go.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Uh, um...!
They don't look back.
Instead, they quietly give a thumbs up.
